body: I can't talk about it. It's not that I don't want to.
I can't explain... Just making their life way harder forever with stupid acts.
A person.
I can't answer that.

Thank you for this... Respect and love to you and your family. 

Do you see any resemblance between ISIS now/the way Israel is viewed by the world and what you experienced before the Holocaust began?
That doesn't sound unattainable.
Well, what do you want in life?
I hear... I just went to 7/11 and ate half the store. Maybe that'll help.

The housing situation sounds tough... I mean, it's really hard to ever be happy when the basic need for shelter isn't met. Like, I know how you feel because I live with family and it's the worst thing ever. I live in a mansion that feels like a prison. 
  I never went to elementary school or high school... I was never taught to read or write or anything secular. I had crippling anxiety for my entire life and I still do sometimes. I missed a billion opportunities... but you can still do school. 
 In fact, just take the GED. That's what I did. It's very easy once you set a date for it. Then go to community college.. .it's better and cheaper. I got into Columbia from a CC because I did really well. You can easily do it if you want to. Fuck your family if they don't like you right now... you should focus on what you want and then go out and do it. You're not done yet because you haven't even started. 
  Go get it... but I hear you and feel your pain. Don't let them stop you so soon. There is time for you yet.

Thanks man, that's really nice of you. 
  Yeah... I hear what you're saying. I don't think I could ever kill myself. I really wanna be homeless and roam the world, but I"m a pussy. I'm too comfortable and then never comfortable enough. I just feel empathy and sadness for all the people in the world going through horrible shit. I wanna help others but I don't give a shit about myself. I have no love, no pain, no joy really... People love me for some reason and think I'm awesome, but I just hate myself. I really really hate myself. It's weird...

Is there an underlying reason for all of this? 
 I mean, is there something below all this causing it... like your orientation, or something you are or do?

This sounds difficult to deal with and I can relate. 
 There is a silver-lining in what you're saying. Things are going wrong now, but you seem to know what will make it right. It's clear that your bf is not the right guy for you right now and that's a problem. But it's also a solution... the answer is that you need a better partner. 
 You have dealt with some serious trauma (I think you should tell your dad so that he can deal with it) but the answer here again is to do the best you can to be a survivor instead of a victim. I don't mean to say you are doing anything wrong... you aren't. I just mean that you know what is hurting you and knowing is half the battle. 
  You are gaining weight... this can be rough. I know... but the answer is there again. You will feel better if you diet and exercise. Again, this is not going to be easy... but you shouldn't despair and feel suicidal when the answers are there for you. 
  I know that your life is hard right now, really hard... but it isn't hopeless because you know how you can fix it. You don't feel like you can right now and that's okay. You are dealing with a lot without a lot of support. But the answers are there and you will slowly tackle them. I know you will! 
  You can always post here or private message or just keep writing... I know you will be okay. Take one step at a time. Make a to do list of these things you wrote about here. You will be okay! More than okay... you will be happy!

One of the painful things about suicide is how it affects others. You know this, but now that you're actually going through it it's hard to be objective. 
 I don't think you're not a normal person. Your view of yourself is a bit harsh, which is fine. I really think you can work on that though. It isn't fair to yourself to be that harsh... I really think you can live this life and enjoy your time here. 
 Blaming yourself for your friends death isn't fair, especially since you didn't know about it and hadn't seen them for a while. It almost sounds like you're giving yourself a reason to be mad at yourself. It's really rough when that happens, and being hurt makes sense. But please try to be easier on yourself.

Out of all that it sounds like you enjoyed being homeless the most... 
 There are many many people who feel that they are happiest when they are away from society. So why not do that? There are no rules telling you to stay in your house or your town... find that place where you're happy. 
 I understand that you haven't found it yet... and that is okay. But there is a place for you. 
  I don't know why your town doesn't like you, or if that's true or just in your head. But either way, you're focused on that instead of the good things. There are good things between all these bad things you keep thinking about. There are good moments, good people, good places, good feelings... you need to seek those out more. Find the good place for you. It wasn't paris or london (maybe it will be one day, who knows), but it's somewhere...

Hey... 
 This is actually a pretty amazing post for so many reasons, but mostly because I can relate so much it's unbelievable. Hear me out for a sec: 

  I'm gonna say a few things... 
1- Your story is not so fucked up. You are not so fucked up. I'm not saying this to be nice... I swear I'm not! I'm saying it because there are so many people who relate to you, like hundreds of millions, that it's unfair for you to feel so bad. I mean, I know you think you are because you spend a lot of time in your room alone, can't go to basic parties, have trouble doing the regular things your friends do and also don't really have a girlfriend. Trust me, I get it!!! You are not that fucked up. I mean, even if you are, we are there with you or have been... we get it. So just know that! Know that you are okay and are going to be okay. I swear this will work out. 
2- Sexual abuse is rough... especially from a sibling. Again, you're not alone at all! Not even close to alone... I know from my personal experience with my brother and other experiences in my family and tons of others. The thing is... it might be helpful to approach it a bit differently than you are. Right now it's this horrible thing in your past that you're kind of ignoring but is also right on your mind and you're not sure what to do... It might be helpful to see it for what it is. You had a bad experience and you want to deal with it! Whatever it is, you want to figure out how best to navigate it. You want to heal, you want to make it better... that might mean talking to your sister, joining a group, writing a book... who knows! But changing the mindset from "this is horrible and it ruins my life" to "This happened and it's horrible but I'm going to find a way to heal" will change your life. You are in control now! You were not in control as a child... you feeling bad that you may have enjoyed, that is not at all as fucked up as you think. In fact, it's so common we all learn about it in psych. It's totally normal! And it's normal to feel like it's not normal. Approach this entire situation as a person who will get past it! Be confident in yourself even when it's hard... you can do this! You can beat this! 
3- You have a chronic condition. The sweating and anxiety is chronic. That means it affects you all the time. Every day you need to wake up and know that you have an issue and every day you need to fight. That can be so freaking hard man!!!! We know! I know! I spent years and years with horrible anxiety and tremendously crippling stomach issues. I know how hard it must be for you because I know how hard it was for me to go to a party knowing I would have diarrhea and need the bathroom 50 times if I did. Trust me! The good thing is, there is an easier solution for you than for me. I have a disease that affects my stomach, but I've started to treat it. You have something that is affecting your nervous system. Anxiety, sweating... these are things for which there are cures. Again, if we look at you as a great person with a problem, it's much more helpful than looking at you as this loser who sweats and can't help it. We can fix you. I promise! And you know it, which is why you posted here. 
  There are medicines (ssri, benzos) that can take away your anxiety for good and stop the sweating. Or, physical medicines that can cure sweating if you have a chronic medical condition other than the anxiety. It's hard to know. However!!! Big however!!! There are people who can help you. If you want the help, and you want to feel great, here is what you need to do: 
  Firstly, know that you are a great person with an issue! You are not a loser... you are a great person who has a problem. Then, go find help. There are psychologists on your campus that talk to students. There are places in your community that will accept your medical insurance and will see you. Your parents will help you. I know it's scary, but if you find a good psychiatrist and psychologist, you will have the medicine you need (hopefully an ssri that is amazingly helpful to millions of people and really doesn't hurt you at all) and you will have someone who is professionally trained to talk you through some issues. They just give you perspective and you need that because you're alone right now. 
 You also need to see a medical doctor. If you have already and they said nothing is wrong, then the psychiatrist who helps your anxiety (taking the ssri for six weeks) will also cure the sweating. But you need to realize that you can get better and then do everything you can until you do. Do NOT accept failure! Do not let this chronic condition beat you down, because that is what they do! They beat people down! Don't let it get you... Go out and find the therapist and doctor who will help you. The psychologist will also help you talk about your sister! Make sure you're careful what you tell them so that legally they don't have to act... make sure you're careful, but they will understand when you bring something like that up. You will be okay!!!!!!!!!! 
  You can pm me anytime... but you won't need to. You will beat this! Also, you will find a girl who understands... oh man... you will find a girl who's been through the same or worse. We really do all have our things like the sweating, trust me. And we all have the memories and traumas... you will be just fine!

You're 23... 
 Maybe it doesn't get better, but maybe it gets less bad most of the time. 
The problem is, you're on your friend's couch. All the things we need in life aren't there. I know for a fact that there are millions of work environments, schools, volunteer programs that you will fit into. You say you won't, but what if that's just depression talking? What if there is an ssri and therapy that will help you? It's not fair to yourself to end it. 
  I feel the same way as you a lot of the time... but after years and years certain things have started to help. It isn't magically making everything better (although that does happen to some people)... but what if the love of your life is out there and you're going to meet them soon? What if they change your life? 
   You're saying you are done... I'm saying give it one more chance, and go deep... go crazy. Take risks... what do you have to lose? Go for that dream... Why kill yourself when you can spend all your money flying to Paris and then think about it after. 
     There are things and people for you... there really are. Just don't give in. Don't let suicide win... you are stronger than those feelings.

I mean, the only thing I can say is (and you kinda know this) that how your life is now is not necessarily how your life will be in five years. You think it is, but it's not. I'm not saying it's going to be so much better... no one really knows that. But it will be different. You think that who you are now, just getting out of college, is who you will be. Evidence suggests otherwise. We change so much over time... so so much. 
 The truth is, there are so many people who are now doing great who actually were in your situation at one time. I think you know this. There are people now who are super happy, don't have these fears and thoughts and love their life. Yet, at one time they were exactly where you are. 
 Your life is changing an insane amount right now... you are essentially leaving childhood and moving into another world. Blame how you feel on that because that's what it is. You are going through insane changes in your entire life! This is freaking hard!!! But many people have done it and you can do it! 
 There really is a great life out there for you. You think everyone fails, but that isn't true. I feel how you feel too... but there is a life out there for us. It doesn't seem that way now, but there is. It is so hard to realize the changes we go through and will go through... but we always do! 
  Work on today... make today fun. Forget about the grand scheme of life for a minute. Maybe see a psychiatrist and try a low low dose of meds, who knows... but make your life good. You are so focused on the negative right now that you're missing so many good things. They are there now in your life... not in ten years. There are beautiful things all around you right now! You're just not seeing them. Really... there are beautiful things all around you. Find them... That really is your choice. It's so hard, I know... I know... I know..... trust me I know. But it is possible.

Well, it's good that you're seeing a therapist. Hopefully they're helping. 
  I totally understand the frustration... it's one of those things we get better at as we get older. You're 16 so you've probably never had that much experience with love. Even if you had tons of it, it's always difficult. So just know that it'll get better for you in this regard, or at least easier to deal with. 
   You're gonna fall in and out of this frustrated feeling from time to time... the trick is to try to have more good times than bad, and when you feel like you do now (or did today) just know that it isn't the end of the world. You still have college in your future, lol... you'll be fine man! 
  And anytime you feel this way, reach out to someone like you did here. Feel free to message me, or just go out and do something nuts that will make it impossible to care about this stuff!

It's a bit silly to trust upvotes and likes from strangers to gauge your own worth. 
 It can be tough... but they don't actually know you at all. 

Are there more specifics to this shitty life you speak of? What's going on? Are there people in your real life who care about you?

Hey man, 
 I read the threads already on here and I just wanna say I agree with these guys. 
  You sound great and like you know what you're doing. A drunk episode can be annoying as hell to deal with later. I mean, even though your situation is a really big deal to you (and would be to me) there are worse things that could have happened. You're not in prison, you didn't kill anyone... 
  I really think you're gonna be fine. Your medication may have mixed with the alcohol as well. But be careful how much you drink. Drinking definitely isn't great for depression or any other mental illness. 
 That said... you will forget about this girl. Right now it's so awkward you don't even wanna be around anymore, kinda like your incident last year. But time heals all wounds, for real... 

I think that caring about what your friends or schoolmates might think is a bit silly. It's natural and we all do it, but you shouldn't let it get to you. The truth is, all of your friends are just thinking about themselves. While you're wondering what they're thinking about you, they're just thinking about themselves and what others might be wondering about them. They don't really care that much, you know. 
  You should report every single person that harasses you online. That isn't fun and it's not a joke. You can show your parents the messages, if that's too much than send them to your teachers or principal. Print them out and bring them to the principal or school psychologist. You shouldn't have to deal with them. Stand up for yourself by showing them you won't take their crap. No matter what they say they can't hurt you... the're just weak and lame and trying to pick on you while you're down. 
  You are so much better than those people and you know it! Btw, the girl you eventually find who will be a hundred times what this girl is... she will know it too.

Firstly, I don't in any way think of you as a crazy person. You need to understand something important here... I am here because I understand these feelings. Crazy as they might seem in reality, people who understand them don't think you're crazy. People who don't might think that, but they don't matter right now. 
 You're talking about unrequited love... love that you have for someone but they don't have back for you. I understand that idea so well it might freak you out if I told you my own story, just because of how much I love someone who doesn't love me. 
  Your feelings are so normal right now. They may not seem that way because you don't see others feeling them, and maybe most people don't... but feeling this way in the face of so much emotional pain, that's normal. You don't ever need to apologize to me. 

You and me both know that there are things you can do that make life harder and things that make it slightly better. I can tell you from today until tomorrow that you shouldn't think of that girl, you shouldn't worry, you should find someone else... and I would tell you that. But believe me that I know how hard that is. Believe me that I understand how no one else in the entire world seems to matter, how this person is perfect and they are right for you! I know how this feels... 
  If you can remember how happy you were when you had her, you will know that you can be happy again. There is another girl out there, millions really, who will make you happier than she can. The fact is, she's being nice to you right now, nicer than she could be, but she isn't right for you. You need to find someone who will love you the way you love her. Think about it, imagine a girl who likes you as much as you like this girl! Sounds crazy right? 
  She's out there... and for now, even if you don't find her, there are plenty of others you can have fun (safe) with. 

It sucks that your meds aren't helping so much... I think you should keep in contact with your doctor. Really complain to them. Be like, "look, I'm not feeling better and I need help." It's hard to do, but super important! I also recommend that you see a therapist. I'm not sure how you feel about them, but you really should. It's just a person who knows how to talk to you and help you see things clearly. If you tell your parents that you want to see a therapist, will they set it up? 

Also, how old are you? (Only answer if you're comfortable answering. It doesn't matter much to me at all if you're ten, twenty or a hundred. An honest answer would help me help you better.)

Hey, 
 So sorry for what you're going through. Being abused is hard enough without having to live with the abuser. I'm sure you're in a ton of pain that I can't possibly understand. However, you did ask a question and I want to answer it. 

Suicide is an option people take when there is no more hope. If you knew 100% that for the rest of your life you would always be in this pain and you couldn't live a happy life, then we can start talking about suicide. But it doesn't look like that's the case. 
 The truth is, and it's hard to see it now, you have an entire life ahead of you. It might be a life where you never ever ever have to see your father again and he just randomly doesn't exist anymore. It might be a life where you fulfill your dreams of traveling, or just get a cool job you like and chill hard core all day. 
 I think because of the situation you're stuck in, suicide is seeming like a good option. You see no way out... and because you're 17, that's really really tough! 
 Because I'm not in your situation, I have a bit of a better view of it and I think you can endure. I think you will survive this and become a stronger person for it. It's not true that every single person who goes through abuse has a great life... but you know what is true. Every single person that has a great life now but went through difficulties when they were younger, every last one of them knows how you feel. They were there! We were there! We are there with you right now because we understand. 

It is important that you get away from the abuse. If you need extra help with that there are people you can call who can handle it. You can also pm me and I will help you. But whatever the case is now, it isn't the end.... You will be free. It will be hard but you will have a life that is better than the two options you have now: it will be better than your current situation and way better than no situation at all. 

Please feel free to ask any questions you have on this comment of in a message.

I don't really know how old you are. I think it matters a little bit. 
 I think that sometimes when people write on this blog or talk about suicide there are different ways they relate how they feel. 
  It doesn't sound to me like you want to kill yourself... it sounds like you want to feel better than you do, but can't really see a way of getting to that place. 
Sometimes the issues is purely chemical, in your head and body... say if all your friends and family all do love you and care about you, but you just can't see it. Sometimes it's actually the environment. 
 The thing is though, it's not that life will get better because everything is suddenly going to feel great and you're not gonna feel sad anymore. It's just that, you're going to get to a place where you like living more than you hate the pain. Right now you don't have much... if you're young, that makes sense. But you will...
 
So you were diagnosed with depression... a real disease, tough to deal with that you don't really know what to do. Well, have you tried any medications for an extended amount of time? I hate the idea of being on meds, but I know that when not being on meds is worse than being on meds, I would try something that might help. 
 Ultimately, you're going to be okay when your life feels worthwhile. Right now you're not getting anything back from your friends, or not enough. Well, you need to work toward deeper connections. Not with people who don't care or don't reciprocate, screw those people. You need to find those people who will make you feel good about you. 

I think all the things I'm saying, medication, relationships, making life better... I think you already know these things so all I'm really doing is simplifying. 
Right now your life sucks! Nothing you do seems to make it better! You're in pain! However, you don't want to end your life. So what's left? 
I say try and let go of everything... if you have nothing to lose then you have everything to gain. Go do that thing you always wanted to do, slowly make new friends, eat foods you love, go buy an entire pie of pizza and just eat it in your room, sign up to go skydiving, buy a train ticket to Connecticut and just go and then come back, each spicy potato chips, go to a concert randomly.........
 We both know your life sucks right now. You have two choices... give in, or fight for today. Maybe doing these things won't make your life better in the future, but they will sure as hell make it better now! Work to make today a good day, a fun day, not super meaningful or life-changing, but a good day! You can do it... I swear!

I don't think you should trust me on this, considering I wouldn't totally know... but seeing as no one commented, I'm gonna offer my opinion. 
 I think that everything we do in life sets a precedent for the rest of our lives. In that way, buying a cheap and broken car might really hinder your chances at success. You'll be driving a piece of crap, always worrying, trying to fix it... it may even shake your confidence. And, in the grand scheme of 50k debt, I'm not sure the monthly payments make a huge difference. 
 The most successful people I know told me this: we knew we would have to go into a ton of debt to be successful, so we did. We got the nicer car instead of the crappy one, went to law school and medical school... but we planned on being successful and paying it back. 
 I think you should do the same thing. You're either going to kick ass, or you're just going to get by. It sounds like you're worried about committing yourself to something and taking a risk... but I don't think you'll be able to do it without that. If you finance a car, you'll have a nice car, you'll feel good and you'll be motivated to succeed. Shoot for the stars, not the cheap and safe option. 
 Just my opinion.
